scope: Author-approved extension of an already analysed retrospective study; not prospective preregistration. Preserve original manuscript and all cross-database findings; local revision only.
sources: Frozen local VitalDB 10-s MAP and objective core60 onset cache; existing NEPI/PHEN stable anchored-60-s merged infusion changes. Existing MIMIC/SICdb bridge retained without new ICU treatment analyses.

fresh.population: All original VitalDB operations; no age>=25 bridge restriction
fresh.episode: At least six consecutive finite 10-s bins with MAP<65. Missing breaks runs. Confirmed onset requires immediately preceding finite MAP>=65. Boundary-onset episodes retained in extended sensitivity.
fresh.clock: Origin is first low-bin start. Value at index j becomes available at (j+1)*10 s; reference and scheduled display update together. Last low-bin value available at the low-run end remains eligible; first normal-bin value is available 10 s later. No future-bin lookahead.
fresh.primary: Fresh current-episode low reading by120s, while last available reference still belongs to that episode; all confirmed-onset events are denominator. Average all grid-compatible phases per event.
fresh.priority: Fresh by deadline first. Otherwise first normal reference available by deadline means recovered; reference missing/end before deadline means unknown; otherwise still low. Inherited low means ever displayed during the low run before deadline, including at onset. Unavailable display separately counted.
fresh.bounds: Fresh lower=observed fresh; upper=observed fresh+unknown. Never delete unknowns from denominator. Complete valid runs must match exact discrete phase enumeration.

recovery.eligibility: Original stable merged changes,>=300s after anaesthesia origin, current completed MAP bin finite and>=5/6 preceding bins finite, current MAP<65; full original300s post-adjustment horizon,>=80% valid; two consecutive normal bins with second ending within300s. Match existing 184-event recovery cohort before extension.
recovery.clock: Zero=second normal-bin completion. Follow to60/120s after recovery even beyond original post-adjustment300s; no future-completeness selection.
recovery.priority: At each tick update reference then scheduled display. Missing/end is unknown. If reference<65 before normal display, recurrent; otherwise normal display clears. Already-normal display at zero clears immediately. Unavailable display is unknown. At deadline apply updates before classifying persistence.
recovery.bounds: Persistence lower=observed persistent; upper=persistent+unknown. Recurrence is an explicit competing state, not independent censoring.

display: Absolute anaesthesia-grid phases 0..interval/10-1; carry last valid scheduled sample through missing scheduled values; unavailable before first sample; never reset at events or hour boundaries.
qc: Original_all, original_matched_core60, core60 on exactly the same qualifying records and uncompressed grid. Mask pre-onset bins only; no additional clinical adjudication. Re-evaluate events and infusion eligibility on each reference. Report changed valid time, events, and display history separately.
strata: Current-event minimum MAP<55 vs55to<65; duration60to<120,120to<300,>=300. No intersections or outcome selection.
restrictions: No causal treatment benefit or safe deadline claims
No manuscript upload or GitHub/Zenodo publication
